_comment: How the player relates to a city, as opposed to what the city is. Relationship is four segments of 100, live state per city: the governor's office (donate / invest, permits), the citizens (shortage relief, aid), the traders (contracts, volume) and one segment held back for later. Rank, permits and the reserved-shelf share read the TOTAL. A favor action names the segment it lands in. Tier locks in goods.json read the total too.

segments.name: Governor
segments.blurb: The office. Gifts, capital and the paper it signs.

segments.name: Citizens
segments.blurb: The streets. Who brought what when the shelves were bare.

segments.name: Traders
segments.blurb: The houses. Contracts honoured and volume moved.

permits.name: Shop permit
permits.blurb: The governor will let you set up a shop in this city. Building it is a later act; holding the paper is the grant.

permits.name: Factory permit
permits.blurb: The governor will let you set up a factory in this city. Building it is a later act; holding the paper is the grant.

actions.name: Donate
actions.blurb: A gift to the governor's office. Goodwill, nothing else.

actions.name: Invest
actions.blurb: Capital into the city's books. The governor notices, and growth ticks up.

actions.name: Aid development
actions.blurb: Ship in what the city is shortest of. Lands in intake, not on the shelf, so it does not cheapen what you buy. The streets notice, not the office.
